hint.note: A gentle 2.8 m/s throw into the wide purple floor patch. Touch it, then let the ball stop. There is no landing target.

campaign.brief: Make your first bounce on the broad atrium floor. Hit the purple patch; anywhere the ball settles is fine.

hint.note: Bank the purple patch on the blue west frontage. Use 8.0 m/s and a slight upward aim, then let the rebound settle anywhere.

campaign.brief: Turn the atrium wall into your first bank. Hit the purple wall patch and watch the ball rebound across the hall.

hint.note: Use full precision charge (12 m/s), a 50° upward aim and no spin. Hit the clock above the central ticket gates, then let the ball settle.

campaign.brief: Look up: the clock above the ticket gates is your target. Bank its purple face and let the rebound drop back through the atrium.

hint.note: Use 8.0 m/s, aim just below level and keep spin at zero. Bank off the left cabinet, then the right, before the ball rolls into the atrium.

campaign.brief: Thread the wide ticket lane with a left-right bank. Collect both cabinet patches before the ball rolls out into the atrium.

hint.note: Use 5.2 m/s with a level aim and no spin. Bank the purple glass patch and let the rebound return to the gold circle beside your start for the landing bonus.

campaign.brief: Bank the glass around the basement opening. Hit its purple patch to clear the level; bring the ball back beside your start for the gold landing bonus.

hint.note: Use 5.5 m/s, aim 30° upward and keep spin at zero. Clear the central glass rim and bounce on the purple B1 floor patch, then let the ball settle.

campaign.brief: Lob over the central glass rim into the basement. Touch the purple floor patch almost five metres below the atrium to clear the level.

hint.note: Use 5.5 m/s, aim 10° upward and keep spin at zero. Bank the pier in front, bounce on the floor, then catch the purple wall patch behind your start.

campaign.brief: Bank the pier in front of you, then the wall behind your launch pad. Collect both purple patches across the B1 aisle and let the ball settle.

hint.note: Use full precision charge (12 m/s), aim 35° upward and keep spin at zero. Bank the ceiling patch, then the floor patch beneath the central glass opening.

campaign.brief: Bank the low B1 ceiling, then the floor beneath the central glass opening. Collect both purple patches as the rebound crosses the public basement.

hint.note: Use 1.0 m/s with a level aim and no spin. Set the ball gently onto the upward escalator and let it carry it to the purple exit plate. The score locks only after the ball stops completely.

campaign.brief: Catch the upward escalator from B1 to the atrium. Touch its moving steps and the purple fixed exit plate at the top, then let the ball settle.

hint.note: Aim through the open frontage at 15° and use 10.0 m/s with no spin. Bank the back wall, let the side wall turn the ball, then collect the inside glass patch. Both purple targets clear the level; let the ball stop completely.

campaign.brief: Thread the open frontage, bank the rear wall, then return onto the inside glass. Collect both purple patches in one shot.

hint.note: Use 8.0 m/s at 10° elevation with no spin. Bank the front window, then the rear window across the walkway. Collect both purple patches and let the ball roll to a complete stop.

campaign.brief: Play the glass bridge above the ticket hall. Bank the purple patch on each side of the walkway in one shot.

hint.note: Use full precision power, 10° elevation and no spin. Bank the sloping ceiling to drive the ball onto the marked lower tread. Collect both patches; the ball may finish on any step once it stops completely.

campaign.brief: Bank the sloping ceiling and drop onto the tiny purple stair tread. Collect both patches before the ball settles on the steps.

hint.note: Use 9.0 m/s precision power, 20° elevation and no spin. Aim just right of east. Bounce on the purple outer ledge, drop onto the floor patch, then bank the small ticket-hall return wall. All three patches count; let the ball stop completely.

campaign.brief: Launch from the balcony, bounce on the outer ledge and drop into the hall. Collect the floor patch and the small return-wall target in the same shot.

hint.note: Use 8.0 m/s precision power, a level aim and no spin. Bank the triangular timber structure, skip across the turf and hit the purple column base. The returning roll can settle in the gold circle for a landing bonus.

campaign.brief: Play two banks across Wood Square: the timber triangle, then the column base. Bring the ball back onto the turf for the gold landing bonus.

hint.note: Switch to POWER and release at 24.0 m/s. Aim 8° down with no spin. Bank the parapet glass, cross to the purple wall patch, then skip onto the marked floor on the return. Collect all three patches and let the ball stop.

campaign.brief: Use the POWER range for a fast zigzag along the promenade: glass, opposite wall, then the floor patch on the return. Collect all three targets.

hint.note: Use 4.5 m/s precision power, 14.5° downward aim and 80 backspin. Hit the small purple tread, then skip down to the broad patch on Muromachi Square. Collect both patches and let the ball stop completely.

campaign.brief: Drop from the first grand-staircase landing onto the marked tread, then bounce out onto Muromachi Square. Backspin controls the first rebound.

hint.note: Use 9.9 m/s precision power, a high 75° lob and maximum backspin (−200). Scout the upper landing with F before aiming. Land on the purple patch and let the ball stop inside the gold ring for the bonus.

campaign.brief: Lob from the seventh to the eighth stair landing and brake with backspin. Touch the purple patch, then settle in the gold ring beyond it.

hint.note: Use 8.0 m/s precision power, 6° upward aim and no spin. Bank the end-wall patch into the low glass guard, then bounce through the broad floor patch toward the garden approach. Collect all three patches and wait for full rest.

campaign.brief: Turn the corner at the top of the grand staircase: end wall, glass guard, then arrival floor. Three targets lead into the garden approach.

hint.note: Use 6.0 m/s precision power, level aim and no spin. Skip off the path into the low planter patch, bounce back through the floor patch, then let the ball stop in the gold ring.

campaign.brief: A low skip among the rooftop benches: bank the planter, collect the return patch and roll into the gold landing ring.

hint.note: Use 8.0 m/s precision power, 24° upward aim and no spin. Bank the concrete patch into the glass patch, then cross the two floor targets as the ball returns from the enclosure. Collect all four patches and wait for full rest.

campaign.brief: Four targets around the garden outlook: concrete, glass, outward floor and return floor. Use the enclosure to bring the ball back across the terrace.

hint.note: Use full 12.0 m/s precision power, 52° upward aim and no spin. Bank the canopy into the hanging platform sign, then collect the floor patch on the return. Wait for the ball to stop translating and spinning.

campaign.brief: Go up into the canopy, bank the hanging platform sign and collect the floor patch as the ball returns along Platform 0.

hint.note: Use 7.0 m/s precision power, 15° upward aim and 100 backspin. Catch the narrow canopy column, bank the station wall, then collect the floor patch on the return. Wait for full translation and spin rest.

campaign.brief: Clip the narrow canopy column, cross back toward the station wall and collect the final floor patch on the return.

hint.note: Use F to scout the roof targets, then return and apply H. Throw at full 12.0 m/s precision power, 55° upward aim and no spin. Skip across both canopy patches, then collect the track-bed patch below. Wait for full translation and spin rest.

campaign.brief: Clear the tracks, skip over both faces of the next platform canopy and collect the patch below as the ball drops from the roof. Use F to scout the roof targets.

hint.note: Apply H for 30° downward aim and 80 backspin, then throw at full 12.0 m/s precision power. Bank off the marked upper tread into the sloping roof, then descend to the platform patch. Wait for full translation and spin rest.

campaign.brief: Drive a downward shot into the upper stair, rebound from its sloping roof and collect the platform patch below. Backspin shapes the descent from the cross-station passage.

hint.note: Apply H for 40° upward aim and no spin, then throw at full 12.0 m/s precision power. Bank off the ceiling and east wall, skip off the floor and collect the west-wall patch. Settle in the gold ring for the landing bonus; wait for translation and spin to stop.

campaign.brief: Complete a ceiling, wall, floor and return-wall circuit beneath the platforms, then settle in the gold ring. Four targets turn this compact passage into a trick-shot course.

hint.note: Apply H for 15° downward aim and 80 backspin, then throw at full 12.0 m/s precision power. Skip onto the marked stair landing, cross both square and balcony patches, then bank the balcony guard into the lower passage patch. Collect all four targets and wait for full rest.

campaign.brief: Follow the grand staircase down to Muromachi Square, then rebound into the public passage below. Four targets span a 25-metre descent through the station.

hint.note: Apply H for 15.5° upward aim and no spin, then throw at full 12.0 m/s precision power. Bank between the two glass walls, skip off the deck and hit the small return-glass patch below the handrail. Collect the floor patch and wait for full rest.

campaign.brief: Thread three glass banks along the Skyway, 45 metres above the station floor. A low return patch tests your control before the final deck target.

hint.note: Apply H for 50° upward aim and no spin in POWER mode. Release at the white 75.0 m/s mark to clear the hotel and bank the tower shaft. Let the ball bounce back across both forecourt patches, then wait for full rest.

campaign.brief: Send a high arc onto Kyoto Tower, then bring it back across two forecourt targets. The shaft patch sits nearly 59 metres above the launch pad.
